mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.content AS content, c.create_time AS create_time, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cv WHERE cv.parent_id = c.id) AS childTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.user_id = #{userId} AND cl.comment_id = c.id) AS upvoteFlag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id) AS upvoteCount, #{userId} AS user_id_param FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.commenter_id WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId} AND c.content_type = #{contentType} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
